towns.name: Tufa
towns.summary: Tufa (13.9S 5.0E, on the A'mun Desert edge just NE of Yaraq) is a Gharu'ndim desert-oasis town that never recovered from the dark night of 11 PY (Fourth Sending of Darkness / Twilight's Gleaming), when Shadow Spires obliterated it - their true target was the Menhir Ring the town had unknowingly been built on. Unlike Arwic it was never rebuilt: the townsfolk live in tents around and inside the crater, some cursing the Shadows, others hoping to rebuild; the Undead Hunters who trade for mnemosynes are based here. In the DAT the crater is a ~100 m bowl whose floor lies at z 0, 20-44 m below the sand rim. On its south wall the Tufa Crater Falls drop 28 m (WaterRunning terrain from z 28 to the floor) out of four retail particle waterfall spouts (0x0200085A, 11 m water sheets) into a mist curtain (0x020003C5); a stream crosses the floor past the broken Tufa Menhir Ring (Menhir Ring Nineteen, four mana fields), the crater Life Stone and a lone tent shop (The Bursting Quiver) lit by a blue-flame lamp. Two ruined two-storey houses with blue-flame lamps stand on the west rim; the surviving 'town' is a small palm oasis 200 m SE with tents, wells, the Nullified Statue of a Skeleton on its pedestal and the Town Network portal. (Culture: Gharu'ndim, not Sho.)
